releaseNotes:
Partely update reliability release
Android 1.5.3 (version code 19) · Windows 1.1.6

- Update checks run immediately in a new app session and refresh every 15 minutes while the app is in use.
- Update manifest requests revalidate cached responses, and missing release assets now show a clear download error.
- Windows release notes can scroll while update actions remain available.
- Inventory part names, vehicle makes, and vehicle models display in uppercase on Android and Windows. Saved values are unchanged.
- Inventory save, opening stock, edit/restock, and rollback fixes are included, along with sales validation and receipt presentation improvements.
